segments.name: Electric vehicles and accessories sales
segments.description: Sells electric vehicles and accessories for short-distance commuting, including e-bicycles, three-wheeled vehicles, batteries and parts.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as a single segment and has one single reportable segment, which is electric vehicles and accessories sales.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for electric vehicles and related accessories, sold as e-bicycles, three-wheeled vehicles, off-highway shuttles, batteries and parts.
revenueModel.evidence: The revenue of this segment is primarily derived from sales of electric vehicles and related accessories.

changes.text: In 2024 the company disposed of Guangzhou LOBO, its software royalties and development and design services segment, leaving one reportable segment.
changes.evidence: On December 11, 2024, the Company completed the disposal of Guangzhou LOBO, which was its software royalties and development and design services segment.
